title: Gift Tax
description: https://www.vero.fi/en/individuals/property/gifts/: A gift is a transfer of property to another person against no compensation or payment. If the total value of the gifts you receive from the same donor in the course of 3 years is €5,000 or more, you must pay gift tax.
